dot.not_carried: tool_operation: Dot takes no image or screenshot input through its packet channel (owner, 2026-10-09) and its per-turn speed is the packet channel's, so tool operation is the channel's own and stays missing, not Astra's.

grok-bot.not_carried: tool_operation: grok-bot's per-turn speed and image recognition are the web channel's own, so tool operation stays channel-specific rather than Opus 5.5's.

capacity_rule.statement: maintainer: grok-bot price and quota capacity follow the same-price Claude subscription

calibration_panel.statement: maintainer: the anchor (0 on every board), the sentinel models whose shared listing defines the core boards, and the panel members, declared (owner 2026-11-18: the members of v0.7.0, the panel the owner's hand-written levels were set against). A row listed on every core board does not join the panel; only the owner changes `members`; a member a core board does not list is an error (calibration/measurements.py)

effort_readings.statement: maintainer: an effort name off the effort scale and the measured effort it reads. The boards list some models without an effort label; that listing is the model's one configuration, which the measurements store under `default` (calibration/measurements.py) and the calibration keys at the effort named here (calibration/five_axis.py aa_rows, time_rows), so a launch at `default` reads the values stored there (five-axis-scores.json `effort_readings`, axis_scores.reading_effort).

families.statement: maintainer: ordered model-family patterns for names the catalog has no row or alias for; the first pattern matching the bare name decides, and the name resolves to the first listed model the catalog has (an empty list: unknown) (scripts/model_resolution.py). `size` is the size class of the names a row decides: `small` names are never in the series of a `full` one (calibration/series.py). `tier_up` on a small row names the pattern of the same line's next larger row, whose first catalogued model is, for a listed member of the small row, its larger model of the same version (calibration/series.py tier_up, five_axis.py tier_down); tier_up_version says whether the larger row's first model is the same version as the small row's current members (`same`) or the nearest version of the same line (`nearest`), calibration/series.py. `tier_up_older` on such a row names, for an older member of the row's line that is not a current member, its larger model and whether it is the same version (`same`) or the nearest (`nearest`).

creative_ideation.scope: Cross-domain association, de-novo concept or mechanism invention, creative writing, narrative dialogue, and open-ended brainstorming.

architecture_reasoning.scope: First-principles system architecture, formal or mathematical reasoning, trade-off critique, and multi-system design planning without modifying source code.

code_implementation.scope: Write, fix, refactor, or test backend, CLI, library, algorithm, configuration, or quantitative/experiment code.

frontend_ui.scope: Implement, refactor, or style user-facing web or desktop UI views, interactive components, charts, layouts, CSS, and animations.

code_audit.scope: Independent read-only review or audit of code, pull requests, diffs, branches, security invariants, or release readiness (including writing a review report file).

exploration_forensics.scope: Read-only codebase exploration, log/database/metric forensics, and runtime root-cause diagnosis on local evidence without modifying code.

web_research.scope: Gather, verify, and synthesize information from the public web, literature, documentation, or vendor sources into a sourced report.

visual_analysis.scope: Static offline inspection of images, photos, screenshots, or design mockups: OCR, UI layout/mockup diffs, and fine-grained aesthetic, styling, material, or lighting classification.

text_processing.scope: Rule-defined structured text cleaning, translation, format conversion, mechanical extraction, and bounded summarization.

live_loop.scope: Low-latency observe-decide-act loop attached to a live external text, WebSocket, or API stream where per-turn response time affects the outcome.

gui_control.scope: Operate a live desktop, browser, or mobile graphical interface via screenshots, mouse clicks, and keyboard actions, or continuously monitor a live visual screen.

other_or_mixed.scope: Unprofiled fallback route when no canonical work_kind was supplied.
